d:
Tirhut shikshak nirvachan kshetr ke chunav men bijepi pratyashi aur endie samarthit narendr sinh ne jit darj ki hai. uplabdh aankron ke mutabik, narendr sinh ko 2,945 vot mile, jabki nirdaliy pratyashi bhushan jha ko 2,351 vot prapt hue. donon pratyashiyon ke bich jit ka antar 594 vot raha. janie tirhut shikshak emaelsi chunav ka parinam aur voton ka pura ganita.
